marketing_wrapper: All 6: pale blue #e4f1fa backdrop with a large bold black two/three-line headline (top ~25%) and a frameless rounded phone screen (no bezel) showing ~65-70% real UI cropped at the bottom. 01 adds Notion's black-ink hand-drawn people illustration perched on the phone and two fanned background screens. The UI itself looks unretouched.

typography.display: Inter-like grotesque, bold for the month title ('October') and semibold for sheet titles ('Manage Calendars', 'Scheduling links'); not SF (straight-legged 'R', Inter-style 't')
typography.body: custom: Inter or very close (Notion's UI face)
typography.numerals: proportional; day numbers regular grey, today in white on a red rounded square; time ranges compact (9:15-9:45...)
typography.weights: bold month titles, medium event titles, regular grey metadata and time gutters
typography.case_and_tracking: sentence case, default tracking; weekday abbreviations two letters (Sa Su Mo)

palette.accent_strategy: Per-calendar colour: each event is a pale tint fill with a 3pt left bar and same-hue text (blue Work, red Family, green Fitness, pink Personal, purple Learning). A red rounded-square marks today and the current-time line. One blue for the primary 'Join Google Meet' button. Chrome is warm off-white and grey.
palette.source: palette.json 04 (#f9f8f6 warm header/sheet surface 32%), 01/02 (#ffffff, #f9f9f9); #e4f1fa is the marketing backdrop; event and today hues read visually

shape.radius_language: mixed small/large: ~4pt event blocks and colour swatches, ~6pt today marker, ~18-20pt grouped cards and the view-picker popover, circles for close and menu buttons
shape.borders_shadows: very light grid hairlines; dotted outline for tentative events ('Update', 'Daily Standup'); soft shadows under floating circular close/menu buttons and the popover
shape.materials: flat; floating white circles with shadow

liquid_glass_visible: no: floating circular buttons are opaque white with shadow
density: high in calendar views (3-day view with 3 time-zone gutters, month grid with '3 more' overflow), medium in sheets
layout: Calendar grid: large month title with up/down chevron switcher, weekday header row with date numbers, time gutter left, tinted event blocks with left colour bars, red current-time line with red time pill. View picker as a rounded popover menu from a floating hamburger circle (Schedule, Month, Week, 3 days, 2 days, 1 day).
navigation: No tab bar. Floating circular hamburger button bottom-left opens the view menu; modal sheets with a floating circular X close button and a centred title; Save as grey text button.
imagery_and_icons: Outline icon set (clock, repeat, person, pin, doc, lines) in grey at ~1.5pt; menu icons show the view geometry (grid, columns). Avatars in participants; the hand-drawn Notion people illustration is marketing-only.
signature_visual_move: Pale per-calendar tinted event blocks with a solid left colour bar and same-hue text, plus a red today marker, on a warm off-white Notion grid.

direction_fit.secondary: posture: unified custom system (Notion web look ported to iOS)
direction_fit.why: Colour per event block on a vertical time axis is the reading layer, which is the Chromatic Timeline signature. It lacks the per-block icon cue that Structured uses, so it is a weak member. The near-white warm neutral matches that direction's restraint rule. It is not Dark Pro Minimal.

notes: Brand identity (the ink people illustration) appears only on marketing. In-app it reads as a clean Notion-styled cross-platform calendar.
